problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: weight 69 tons
* Shipment Beta: weight 58 tons
* Shipment Gamma: weight 40 tons
* Shipment Delta: weight 66 tons
* Shipment Epsilon: weight 54 tons
* Shipment Zeta: weight 44 tons
* Shipment Eta: weight 38 tons
* Shipment Theta: weight 46 tons
* Shipment Iota: weight 31 tons
* Shipment Kappa: weight 59 tons
* Shipment Lambda: weight 50 tons
* Shipment Mu: weight 60 tons
* Shipment Nu: weight 52 tons
* Shipment Xi: weight 62 tons
* Shipment Omicron: weight 44 tons
* Shipment Pi: weight 49 tons
* Shipment Rho: weight 66 tons
* Shipment Sigma: weight 31 tons
* Shipment Tau: weight 61 tons
* Shipment Upsilon: weight 38 tons
* Shipment Phi: weight 47 tons
* Shipment Chi: weight 43 tons
* Shipment Psi: weight 53 tons
* Shipment Omega: weight 30 tons
* Shipment A1: weight 48 tons
* Shipment B1: weight 69 tons
* Shipment C1: weight 57 tons
* Shipment D1: weight 44 tons
* Shipment E1: weight 30 tons
* Shipment F1: weight 44 tons
* Shipment G1: weight 68 tons
* Shipment H1: weight 54 tons
* Shipment I1: weight 38 tons

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 tons. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total weight on a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
